# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/focus_compiler.mjs) from docs/design/focus/shared_dark_lands.json. Do not edit.
zin_shared_dark_lands_moot_goodwill = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_dark_is_free_hold = yes
			NOT = { tag = ROOT }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = zin_shared_dark_lands_hold_kin }
		ROOT = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_shared_dark_lands_hold_kin } }
	}
}

zin_shared_dark_lands_gain_autonomy = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject = yes
		}
		add_autonomy_ratio = {
			value = 0.2
			localization = zin_shared_dark_lands_slip_the_yoke
		}
	}
}

zin_shared_dark_lands_access_against_dead = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = zin_region_dark_lands
			has_war_with = ZOL
			NOT = { tag = ROOT }
		}
		give_military_access = ROOT
		ROOT = { give_military_access = PREV }
	}
}
